title: Battle of Big Bethel
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Big Bethel", at revision 1370434284, opens: "The Battle of Big Bethel, also known as the Battle of Bethel Church or Great Bethel, was one of the earliest land battles of the American Civil War. It took place on the Virginia Peninsula, near Newport News, on June 10, 1861." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q794695, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1861 early battle of the American Civil War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
